children: Singapore pain management provider's full-year revenue rose 5.4% yr/yr to S$27.38 mln
Company posted net profit of S$42,000, reversing prior-year net loss
Company did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook in the provided materials in the press release
IMPAIRMENT LOSSES - Lower impairment losses on goodwill and investments contributed to the swing to profitability
GP CLINIC GROWTH – Revenue rose 5.4% to S$27.38 mln as new GP clinics and organic growth offset lower specialist and allied-health revenue
LOWER REBRANDING COSTS – Other expenses fell S$0.69 mln as marketing and consultancy spending declined after FY2025 rebranding initiatives ended
PUXIANG FAIR-VALUE GAIN – Share of joint-venture results swung to a S$0.32 mln gain from a S$0.73 mln loss, mainly due to a fair-value gain on its Puxiang investment
